paper.title: Spin-1/2 kagome Heisenberg antiferromagnet: Machine learning discovery of the spinon pair density wave ground state
paper.authors: Tanja Duric, Jia Hui Chung, Bo Yang, Pinaki Sengupta

results.system_description: Heisenberg, 4 × 4 cells · 48 sites · J = 1 · periodic · Sz = 0. H = J sum_<ij> S_i · S_j; spin-1/2 operators S = sigma/2; J = 1; no constant shift
results.variant: 6 layers of 6 feature maps, fully symmetric, spin parity +1
results.eligibility_evidence: Converged variational energy E = <psi|H|psi>/<psi|psi> of the GCNN ground state in the total Sz = 0 sector (Results section, Fig. 4), printed with its error.
results.notes: Total energy of the 48-site (4 x 4 x 3) kagome cluster with periodic boundaries, spin-1/2 operators, J = 1 (Hamiltonian eq:H); the exact-diagonalization energy -21.057787063 is printed in the same sentence. The 108-site GCNN energy of the paper, -48.18(0), lies below the DMRG energy and is disputed (arXiv:2605.28861); it is not recorded.
